definition: Wayve Technologies Ltd is a British autonomous driving technology company focused on developing self-driving vehicle systems through end-to-end deep learning.
details: Founded in 2017 by researchers from the University of Cambridge, Wayve’s approach eschews detailed 3D maps and hand-coded rules, in favour of a self-learning "AI driver" that learns from camera data and driving experience.

explainer.lead: Wayve Technologies Ltd is a British autonomous driving company developing self-driving systems through end-to-end deep learning, founded in 2017 by University of Cambridge researchers. Its approach matters because it drops detailed 3D maps and hand-coded rules.

tiers.eli5: Rather than being taught every street in advance, the car learns to drive by watching camera footage and practising, like a person gaining experience behind the wheel.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers build a self-learning "AI driver" that learns from camera data and driving experience instead of relying on detailed 3D maps and hand-coded rules.
tiers.paperLevel: End-to-end deep learning for driving: a self-learning model maps camera input to driving behaviour, eschewing detailed 3D maps and hand-coded rules.

explainer.example: A vehicle trained on camera data and driving experience learns to drive without a prebuilt 3D map of the route.
